items.title: Trio Ternura :: A Gira / Razão De Ser
items.summary: Trio Ternura—the Brazilian sibling group consisting of sisters Jussara and Jurema and brother Robson Ternura—has been receiving the reissue treatment via Madrid’s Vampisoul label since last year and we are absolutely here for it.
